name: selection
description: File-level selection across a history of real commits: import, conftest, declaration and content-read closure over the base and head trees, global inputs, deleted files, unparseable source, and selection against the history's first commit.

actions.init: create a fixture repository and commit it
actions.edit: rewrite one file's body, commit, then select
actions.link: add an import to one file, commit, then select
actions.unlink: remove an import from one file, commit, then select
actions.remove: delete a file, commit, then select
actions.restore: add a deleted file back without imports or declarations, commit, then select
actions.declare: add a # gv:test-dependency: comment to a test, commit, then select
actions.undeclare: remove a # gv:test-dependency: comment, commit, then select
actions.breakSyntax: make a Python file unparseable, commit, then select
actions.repair: make an unparseable file parse again, commit, then select
actions.touchGlobal: edit requirements.txt, a default global input, commit, then select
actions.inspect: read the last selections without committing

limits: One repository: three modules, a test-root helper, a root and a nested conftest, three tests, one data file and one content-kind sidecar; at most 8 commits per sampled history.

Covers import, ancestor-conftest, import-kind comment and content-kind sidecar edges, file deletion, unparseable source, the default global inputs, and selection against both the previous commit and the history's first commit. First-party pins, name-scoped modules, deferred strings, Django URLconf policy and plugin-registering test modules are outside the model.
Each step is a real Git commit selected by affected() through one GraphCache per history; the driver's mapping of paths to file names is trusted.
